definitions.window: Decision steps 274..298 inclusive, 25 turns ending at state 299.
definitions.subset: Every final loss plus every win with absolute final margin <=350. All other wins retained as a descriptive control.
definitions.geometric_reach: Shortest toroidal path with no other workers or blockers. The 15x15 board has maximum toroidal distance 14; all loads are geometrically reachable at steps 250,275 and 285. Steps 290,294,297,298 also saved as reachability summaries.
definitions.initial_carbon: Only carbon already carried at state 274. Tag proportions follow transfers among workers, bank payouts and tree taxes. Ground spills end attribution.
definitions.blocked: Hindsight candidate only. For opponent return of >=30 at t, look at the preceding t-1 decision: a lighter defender could step to the opponent's recorded non-depot approach cell. Same-turn collisions on the depot can still bank for its owner.
definitions.counterfactual: Both rules are public-information rules; other own and all opponent orders are frozen, with missing or reassigned archived IDs counted. Counterfactual outcomes are not wins against a responding opponent.
